posts.text: Chip-equipment, optical, and memory shares rose sharply on Nov. 3 after a month-long slide, but the evidence points to several drivers rather than one common cause.
posts.source_title: Chip-equipment, optical, and memory shares rose sharply on Nov. 3 after a month-long slide, but the evidence points to several drivers rather than one common cause.

posts.text: Nov. 3's bounce came from previously beaten-down electrical, power, and AI-equipment groups, while the real-estate and rail groups that had supported the index did not lead.
posts.source_title: Nov. 3's bounce came from previously beaten-down electrical, power, and AI-equipment groups, while the real-estate and rail groups that had supported the index did not lead.

posts.text: Apple's holiday-quarter warning that it will keep less profit from each sale, not a sales miss, sent its stock lower on Nov. 3 while other large technology shares rose.
posts.source_title: Apple's holiday-quarter warning that it will keep less profit from each sale, not a sales miss, sent its stock lower on Nov. 3 while other large technology shares rose.

posts.text: Energy shares split by business on Nov. 3; oil producers and drillers stayed weak after Iran-deal hopes lowered oil, but no actual supply change is confirmed.
posts.source_title: Energy shares split by business on Nov. 3; oil producers and drillers stayed weak after Iran-deal hopes lowered oil, but no actual supply change is confirmed.

posts.text: Restaurant suppliers fell after Sysco's softer traffic warning; ADM and Keurig Dr Pepper dropped on separate reports with unresolved drivers.
posts.source_title: Restaurant suppliers fell after Sysco's softer traffic warning; ADM and Keurig Dr Pepper dropped on separate reports with unresolved drivers.

posts.text: Shopify fell 8.7% after a tiny sales miss and a softer fourth-quarter profit outlook, not because demand collapsed.

posts.text: Lattice Semiconductor and Fabrinet rose on their own strong sales, showing the chip rebound was not one uniform trade.

posts.text: Lumentum's discount to the Marvell share package widened to 12.1% on Nov. 3 even as optical peers rallied; the pattern remains more consistent with deal-closing risk than weak operations.

posts.text: Crypto-mining and computing-hosting shares rebounded about 14.6% while Bitcoin stayed near $77,000; the same-day cause is not established.
